# Archived curl implementation

Replaced after the user supplied a Paper video showing centre-hinged folding. Original source is retained unchanged in archived-source; it is not packaged in the current APK. Earlier import notes follow.

# harism/android-pagecurl

Source: https://github.com/harism/android-pagecurl, master snapshot downloaded 2026-10-05.
Apache-2.0; original headers preserved. CurlMesh.java and CurlPage.java are imported directly.
The app adds a TextureView / EGL host and solid book geometry; the curl algorithm is upstream.
The copied mesh SHA-256 is recorded in provenance.json. License is packaged with the APK.
